what: resolveCanvasDirection — the body-root's `direction` propagated to the composed canvas's ICB div, gated by the SAME bodyRootHasContainment predicate the background and writing-mode propagations use (css-contain-1 §3.1 names `direction` in the same clause as `writing-mode`). Silent for no-body-root, no declaration, the initial `ltr`, containment, or a non-keyword value.

resolveCanvasTextAlign — the body-root's `text-align` on the same ICB, and ONLY when the direction propagation fired. Repairs a harness artifact (in the flat v2 forest a top-level INLINE root's line box belongs to the ICB, not to a body box), not a spec propagation.

dirAttributeRoute.what: 9 of the 42 population tests declare the root direction with an html/body `dir=` ATTRIBUTE instead of a CSS rule. HTML §14.3.1 makes that a presentational `direction` declaration, so css-writing-modes-4 §8 propagates it exactly like the rule — but extract-fixture's `documentDirectionality` reads the attribute only for `:dir()` matching, and the value never lands on the body-root property bag. resolveCanvasDirection is therefore silent for all 9.
dirAttributeRoute.worth: css-align/self-alignment/self-align-safe-unsafe-{flex,grid}-003, both at 0.8015 with a 100%-displaced inline axis: capture ink bbox x:17..74 where the frozen ref has it at x:314..372 (orange band identical at 33,600 px in both). The other 7 need nothing — css-text/text-align-match-parent-root-{ltr,rtl,logical} and selectors/dir-{style-02a,pseudo-update-document-element} are already at SSIM 1.0000, and css-ruby/ruby-bidi-001/003 are blocked by the presence + coverage-ratio vetoes on a `color: transparent` near-blank page, not by direction.
dirAttributeRoute.cost: those two css-align documents emit NO body-root component at all (their only root-scope declaration is the attribute), so delivering the value means the extractor MINTING a body-root — a flat-list shape change that reaches all three runtimes and needs a device A/B. Adding the property to an EXISTING bag (the css-ruby shape) is additive and cheap but worth zero measured cells. Also: tools/titan/extract-fixture.mjs is being edited by lane N4 in the same worktree this wave, so a structural edit there is a live merge hazard.
dirAttributeRoute.next: one wave with a device port: mint the body-root from documentDirectionality, then A/B css-align + css-ruby + selectors + css-text on all three platforms.

containWritingModeEight.whyNotThisLane: this is exactly the TODO already written into runtimes/web/src/renderer/RootPseudoPlacement.ts ("NOT YET COVERED — the block axis"). Its `margin-right: auto` pin is an INLINE-axis lever and, per that file's own headless-Chromium probe, cannot reach the block axis (no pin dx=100, margin-right:auto dx=100, writing-mode on the box itself dx=100). generalTextAlignHole.what: resolveCanvasTextAlign is gated on the direction propagation, but the artifact it repairs is general: an LTR document with `body { text-align: center }` and a top-level INLINE root has the same hole, because the line box belongs to the ICB and the extractor's text-align bake lands inertly on the inline box.
generalTextAlignHole.whyGated: closing it generally rewrites the ICB style of every fixture whose body declares an alignment, corpus-wide, on zero measurement. Recorded as a follow-up with its own A/B rather than smuggled in behind a measured RTL change.
